snapshot.title: IT: HMI and PLC-02 Status Verification

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: ops
transcript.text: IT, this is ops. I need you to confirm the status of the MBW-HMI-01 system. Is the manual override on IC-2 locked in? And can you verify that no remote session has modified the HMI or PLC-02 during the process? We need to preserve the chain of custody and ensure no unauthorized access occurred during isolation.

transcript.speaker: it
transcript.text: Confirmed, Director. MBW-HMI-01 is in local mode. The manual override on IC-2 is locked in and tagged per Section 8.1. No remote session on MBW-HMI-01, MBW-JUMP-01, or MBW-FW-01 has been detected since 07:00. All access logs, including MBW-JUMP-01 session recordings and MBW-FW-01 firewall logs (FW-R-09, FW-R-17, FW-R-22, FW-R-31), show no anomalies. PLC-02 program integrity is confirmed. Chain of custody remains intact.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms that the manual override is locked and no remote access occurred during isolation. The IT team must validate log integrity and prevent any rollback without full audit.
